name: Hampstead United Methodist Church
description: Hampstead United Methodist Church is a working farm in 15395 U.S. highway 17 North, NC. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
